notes.note: Reviewed the 394ae79a engine-setup classifier delta and affected cited scope claims. Only seven exact ACP leaves gain explicit declarations; GETs retain orchestration:read, mutations retain orchestration:operate. Matcher, scope implication, token classes, all existing route families, enrollment, passkey/device and terminal socket rules are unchanged. Installer handlers still require current personal-owner authority plus terminal and host-command authority; reads expose terminal metadata only after that guard. Checked the canonical API/Connections/terminal/threat-model claims and the impacted source references: they remain accurate; historical captures and policy/dependency documents gain no new runtime qualification. 352 focused tests passed. A frozen-source fault replacing installer operate scope with terminal-only scope produced the intended two assertion failures, then byte-restored source passed all189 scope tests. No prose correction or new provider/native proof is claimed.
